title: Grateful Dead Live at University of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: AKG 414 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLII-S/TDK MA-R)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑recorded FLAC captures a high‑energy, smoking 1982 show with solid sound quality despite a few unexpected country moments.
ai_review.review: The concert is described as “smoking” and full of energy, with the audience recording smoothing out the typical harshness of ’82 soundboards, resulting in a pleasant listening experience. While most listeners enjoyed the vibe, one reviewer was put off by an unanticipated country‑style turn (El Paso), giving the overall impression a mixed but largely positive feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is generally praised for high energy and good performance; recording is noted as clear and smoother than typical ’82 soundboards, but limited detail and a negative comment lower the overall confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience mic (AKG 414) smooths the edges of the often harsh ’82 soundboards, delivering clear and balanced audio without major distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall flow is energetic and well‑received, though a surprise country number interrupts the psychedelic vibe for some listeners.
